blocks: Generates hands-on, multi-part technical tutorials on demand, with LLM skills tuned to make content approachable. Work through the generated tutorials yourself, by hand.
In this Knowledge Garden, Launchpad means the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3. Other Launchpad models belong under the Novation/Launchpad namespace.
Launchpad/UG - the launchpad user guide (adapted from the PDF)
Launchpad/PRG - the launchpad programmers reference (adapted from PDF)
Launchpad/Scale - quick pointers to info about Music Scales
Launchpad/UI - references to the Launchpad UI

The Launchpad Pro holds eight Custom Modes, one per slot. Open Launchpad/UI/Mode/4-Custom with the Custom button, then press Track Select button 1 to 8 to choose slot 1 to 8 (Launchpad/UG/08 Custom Modes/02 Default Custom Modes).
Each slot starts with a factory layout (Launchpad/UG/11 Appendix/01 Default MIDI Mappings). Sending a mode from Novation/Components to a slot replaces whatever the slot held.

Launchpad/Custom/<Slot>/<Name> — one page per mode built in Components, where <Slot> is the slot it is made for, from 1 to 8. Several modes can be made for the same slot, but the Launchpad holds only one of them at a time. See Logseq/Entity/Launchpad/Custom/Mode.
Launchpad/Custom/Pad/Mode — the Components setting for how a pad behaves when pressed and released.
Launchpad/Custom/1/Ableton-Ctrl — on the Launchpad since 2026-11-19 Thu.
Launchpad Custom Mode for controlling Ableton/Live's transport, Arrangement Record and locators from the top of the grid, with one fader below them.
Every control sends a MIDI CC on channel 16. Grid rows 3 to 8, three pads in row 1 and all edge buttons have nothing assigned.
Message: CC 114, channel 16. Moved from CC 116 on 2026-11-19 Thu, which it shared with the Set Locator pad.
Behavior: Launchpad/Custom/Pad/Mode Momentary; on value 127, off value 0.
Behavior: Toggle; on value 127, off value 0.
Controls: Ableton/Live/UI/Control Bar/Button/Arrangement Record (Global Record in Live's MIDI Mappings list).
